The *Dhammadhajajātaka* (Ja 220) is a narrative belonging to the Pali *Jātaka* collection. In the edition of the *Jātaka* commentary by V. Fausböll, the text concludes as the tenth story (*dasamaṁ*) of its vagga [Fausböll 1879].

**Sources**
